overview: Finalize simulation coverage by implementing deterministic state compression for ultra-endgame scenarios, optimizing Monte Carlo convergence, and enhancing colonist psychological modeling with atomic, zero-heap C++20 constructs.

tasks.title: Implement Zero-Heap Deterministic State Compression
tasks.architectural_spec: Use C++20 concepts for compile-time type checking. Implement a fixed-size array-based compressor for simulation states. No dynamic allocations. Use std::span for view-based access. Ensure deterministic serialization order.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: State compression ratio > 80%. Zero heap allocations. Deterministic output across runs. Unit tests pass with 100% coverage.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Faster load times and consistent simulation results.

tasks.title: Optimize Monte Carlo Convergence for Endgame States
tasks.architectural_spec: Implement a fixed-iteration Monte Carlo solver with early termination based on variance thresholds. Use C++20 ranges for data processing. Avoid recursion; use iterative state updates.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Convergence within 1000 iterations. Variance < 1e-6. No deadlocks. Performance improvement > 20% over previous version.
tasks.player_fun_impact: More accurate and faster endgame predictions.

tasks.title: Enhance Colonist Psychological Modeling with Atomic Updates
tasks.architectural_spec: Use std::atomic for shared psychological states. Implement a lock-free update mechanism for mood and stress levels. Ensure thread-safe reads and writes with minimal overhead.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: No data races detected. Update latency < 1ms. Consistent psychological states across threads.
tasks.player_fun_impact: More responsive and consistent colonist behavior.
